details.description: Meet the Nippo Thor — built for devices that demand the best. Whether it's a high-speed RC car, a DSLR camera, or a heavy-duty torch, Thor AA batteries deliver relentless, long-lasting power that won't quit when it matters most. This is not just a battery. This is imum power, imum performance.
details.usageInstructions: Insert into the device matching the + and - marks. Replace all batteries together.
details.dangerWarnings: Do not recharge, short-circuit, open or throw into fire. Do not mix old and new or different types of batteries. Remove from devices not in use. Keep away from children; seek medical help if swallowed.
